changes: Current generic candidate demonstratives use Unicode letter/mark/number boundaries; an accented -là suffix is consumed as one token and a longer nominal token cannot match by prefix.

Complete recognized decisions require UNIQUE_CURRENT plus nonempty candidateRef, sourceTurnRef and sourceDigest. Otherwise a new client-local CLARIFY_CANDIDATE_REFERENCE carries no target refs and cannot authorize Project writes.
The clarification kind is added to the existing interaction type only. Its local Workspace rendering and server-parser exclusion are separately owned concurrent changes.

Assisted-proposal requests recognize generic présenter imperatives, explicit proposer/suggérer imperatives without a domain-object lexicon, subject-modal requests and inverted interrogatives after a contextual preamble. Negative, quoted and hypothetical proposal clauses remain excluded.

One existing Scientific Thinking test fixture now supplies the actual selection-turn identity and digest instead of asserting UNIQUE_CURRENT with null provenance. No Scientific Thinking production code changed in this wave.
safetyPreserved: No adoption by candidate recency; ambiguous or stale references carry no authorization.
No widening of uniquement/seulement, partial decisions, quoted decisions, conditions, negation, or mixed decision plus new scientific content.
Proposal purpose is non-authoritative and preserves full-turn extraction; no direct Project mutation.
